messages:
amy: Heads-up — customer legal wants confirmation that during the POC we can keep all inference traffic and logs inside EMEA. They also want the full subprocessor list (esp any CDN or regional infra partners) and an estimate for any price delta if we force eu-only routing. POC starts Mon morning. cc @jordan @priya :wave:
jordan: Short answer: hosted API can prefer EMEA endpoints and we have EU model variants. Default is latency/cost-first routing across compatible endpoints. We support a region_preference header to bias routing to eu-only pools. If eu capacity is saturated we currently fall back to nearest compatible region unless you pass fail_if_unavailable=true. :thinking:
priya: Security note: current subprocessor list includes the EU CSP partner (eu-west-1) and a CDN partner with nodes in IE/DE. I'll attach the exported subprocessor CSV to the customer NDA workspace. All data-at-rest is encrypted and keys can be customer-managed for Private deployments. Link: https://redwood.company/legal/subprocessors (internal).
marcus: For POC we can set region_preference: eu in the request header or pin the session to an EU model variant. Example curl for the bias header:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Region-Preference: eu" \ 
  -d '{"input":"..."}' \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
This will keep requests routed to EU pools; latency may go up slightly depending on customer location. Cost delta is usually small but depends on instance type.
amy: Helpful — can you give a ballpark cost delta we can put in the SOW? Customer asked for numbers today.
jordan: Ballpark: if we avoid cheaper global egress and force eu-dedicated routing expect ~+5–12% on per-token cost for hosted; for dedicated/reserved capacity it depends on GPU SKU and utilization (could be neutral or slightly higher). If you want firm pricing for the SOW we should provision a small reserved pool for the POC (1-2 GPUs) and I can run a perf/cost estimate. Also: to avoid silent fallbacks set fail_if_unavailable=true — otherwise requests will route to fallback and still succeed.
priya: Legal also asked about whether any logs leave EMEA. Currently request/response KV cache and metrics are retained in region for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted we replicate metrics to US for analytics; we can offer reduced telemetry retention for enterprise POCs on request. Do they need KMS in their tenancy?
amy: They prefer customer-managed keys but for POC they may accept our KMS if we add a contract clause. Can you generate the subprocessor CSV now so I can send it?
priya: Uploading exported list to the shared drive and DMing the NDA link. Will also add a note about telemetry retention and the KMS option.
legal-bot: Automated: POC-SLA-v2.pdf uploaded to /legal/attachments/POC-177999 — please tag with customer name to auto-generate SOW stub.
deploy-bot: POC env (eu-west-1) requested by amy is scheduled for provisioning at 2026-04-06T08:00Z. ETA ~15m.
amy: Great — I'll share subprocessor CSV with customer and propose the reserved pool + fail_if_unavailable=true for the POC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
